The line item totals match the campaign daily spend. Combined spend is $542.59. Impressions are 446,145. Link clicks are 278.

The campaign spent $542.59 of its $550 budget, leaving about $7.41 unspent. The overall cost per click is roughly $1.95. By creative, the explainer performed best at $3.03 per click and 0.025% CTR, followed by ghost at $2.16 and 0.049% CTR, urgency at $1.81 and 0.076% CTR, and the $0 line item at $2.21 and 0.047% CTR. The urgency cap was nearly reached, with only $0.04 remaining.

The campaign ran October 27–31 and expired. The Sunday urgency post drove most clicks at the lowest cost.

The plain explainer was paused after it stopped earning clicks. The campaign was limited to the United States on iPhone and Android. Trial starts are tracked internally, so the recap will focus strictly on spend, impressions, and link clicks.

The Halloween flight is wrapped. It ran October 27 through October 31, Eastern time, and has ended.

**Spend:** $542.59
**Impressions:** 446,145
**Link clicks:** 278

That is $1.95 per link click. X could not count trial starts, since the site has no X pixel, so link clicks to https://lanternfox.app/halloween were the on-platform number we optimized for. Your own trial-start count is the one that matters.

The Sunday urgency post did most of the work: 179 link clicks and $324.29. Ghost stories added 57 clicks ($122.85), and the "$0 for 14 days" post added 39 ($86.37). The plain explainer barely got clicks, so it was paused after the first day (3 clicks, $9.08). Delivery stayed in the United States on iOS and Android.
